free_tier.stated: No file storage at all. Community Users may create filtered views and visualisations of EXISTING public datasets; there is no upload of new bytes.

record.chaining: None. A community asset is a query/saved view, not an object.
record.limits_note: Write-gated and restricted in capacity. Terms state: 'A community user is limited to creating two assets per day per site', and allowed asset types are filtered views and visualizations (charts, graphs, maps). Does not support raw bulk binary storage.
record.reliability_note: None needed. It cannot store files, so it cannot fail on retention or egress.
